consumer: An external combat-log analysis script that reads each monster's exported current-HP integer as ground-truth damage data; it asks 'what is this monster's raw current HP right now?', not a yes/no the engine computes.
scope: Each individual monster entity's own raw current-HP field (per-monster scalar); not a region, predicate, or carried-items inventory.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters) — writes mon.get_hp() and mon.get_hp_max() straight from the engine getters with no formatting, filtering, or predicate evaluation, i.e. raw authoritative state.
divergence: A monster wounded to current HP 5 of max HP 20: if the export emitted get_hp_max() (20), a stale/cached value, or 0 instead of the true raw 5, the combat-log script records wrong damage — exposing a non-raw answer whenever current HP diverges from max HP.
